input.summary:
parts/shell.mjs builds the plinth, y1 mosaic/grass/socle floor, every wall run (plaster + dado, raised high sides), pocket, fauces door, four shop openings with shutters, atrium/tablinum/peristyle/triclinium doors, and the iron-bar windows. The shell line reports 5986 placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE. build.nbt (36x10x52) is in place from a manual build; check shows 0 floating and 0 unsupported blocks, and the front and oblique renders read as a walled villa.
Added walls at z=14, z=28 and z=39 (x0..8 and x27..35) so the cubicula close, and recorded that in plan.md Notes.
left: make.sh does not finish: its roof step runs `mcd roof --dry-run` once shell.mjs is no longer a stub, and that crashes on a roofless building (largest() reduces an empty rect list, tools/src/roofs.mjs:142). The roofs part, or a stub gate in make.sh that also checks roofs.mjs, has to fix it. I ran build.mjs by hand and moved the result into build.nbt; make.sh itself was not edited because it is outside my module.
Pediment (E02) is not built: the pocket cells at y6 x16..19 and y7 x17..18 are carved to air for the roofs part.
Atrium red medallion (E17) is not built: the impluvium takes the centre. The tablinum 2x2 medallion is built.
Floor cells left as air at y1 for later parts: impluvium box, fountain box, bed cells (x13..14 and x21..22, z31..36), path legs (x17..18, z27..29 and z38..40).
Plan gap filled: cubicula walls at z=14, z=28 and z=39 (recorded in plan.md Notes); the y1 socle under walls is polished_andesite.
